cohort: 506 women referred to a tertiary-referral perineal clinic after primary repair of OASI (Grade 3a-c, 4) diagnosed following vaginal delivery
finding: One in 11 women diagnosed with a Grade-3a or -3b tear have evidence of damage to their IAS on endoanal ultrasound, which is linked to fecal incontinence and can impact future delivery planning.
mod_finding: Damage to the internal anal sphincter (IAS) during childbirth can have a significant impact on the planning of any future deliveries.
